occupation or other identifying information that is unrelated
or incidental to the provision of telecommunications

numbers involved; and
(f) telegraphic, facsimile, telephonic or any other
such type of communication.
(3) The records of interception shall be compiled either
contemporaneously, or within a reasonable period of time following
the initiation of the interception of the communications and such
period shall not exceed 90 days.
(4) A telecommunications provider shall maintain a record
of all intercepted communications for a period of 6 years.
